tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥawwah, associated with ḥayah, 'to live' (Genesis 3:20). Its root is Hebrew ḥ-w-h. Eve, the first woman (Genesis 3:20). Eva is a Hebrew name meaning “Life; living”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
